heading: INT. RUDDY & GREEN BUILDING - ELEVATOR
summary: Rose and Mariner ride the elevator after a violent rescue. Rose discovers a skull fragment on the floor while muzak plays. Mariner is introduced in full — a hulking vigilante in fishing-themed costume with an oar, net cape, and shell bandolier. Rose confronts him about being late to pick her up, and he reveals he tracked her via an AirTag on her phone, sparking a trust conflict between them.
